card.title: Reality Is Coming Apart
card.instruction: Treat each contradiction, coincidence, and ordinary mistake as evidence that reality is losing structural integrity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've said 'the rent's due' twice. Time's slipping in this flat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you didn't hear me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then sound's failing too. We should tell the landlord.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I am the landlord. Shall I write it down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please. Date it, so we'll know whether tomorrow still arrives.

mechanism: A reads repeated rent speech, hearing correction and the landlord's identity as signs of unstable time and sound.
confusable: Unlike simple suspiciousness about another person, A attributes the discrepancies to reality itself losing continuity.
comparison: The rent alternative seeks a dated record to check tomorrow; the lift alternative spells floor labels to protect the building.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
